text.tspan: Weekly Report
To:Tom Ulaszek
From:Marty Pennock
Subject:Status Report
Date:September 17, 1992
Accomplishments
1.Finished STBook System Specification in PageStream, Word Perfect 5.1, and Wordstar
formats. Distributed hard and soft copy to Tom Ulaszek and Richard Miller.
2.Began scanning art for STBook Service Guide. Scanning all external views for connector
locations.
3.Began Theory of Operation section of STBook Service Guide. Covered Motorola Processor
Section.
4.Archived hard and soft copies of FALCON030 and FALCON040 System Specifications.
5.Began Vectorizing scanned images for STBook Service Guide.
6.Backed up TT030 and ABC386DXII.
7.Turned in copies of drawings for STBook needed to Document Control for reproduction as
a backup. Will call Jim Campbell about possible archive copies in Sunnyvale.
8.Finished all text edits to Chapter One of the STBook Service Guide.
9.Contacted Richard Miller about comments on FALCON030 Service Guide Draft.
10.Received FALCON040 MCU ASIC Specification from Scott Lewis in both hard and soft
formats.
11.Got part numbers assigned for STBook and FALCON040 System Specifications.
12.Made copy of JADEC FALCON030 PAL/GAL code for Scott Barrows
13.Incorporated Power Supply information into STBook Service Guide.
Plans
1.Produce Service Guides for STBook, Portfolio, 2600, Falcon040, and 7800 products.
2.Complete specifications for archive of COMBEL, VIDEL, SDMA, ADMA, BDMA, VIO,
and MCU ICs.
3.Produce FALCON030 Service Guide Final Draft and ship to subs.
